extraction_warnings: Paper reports data primarily at the subgroup level (control, pHTN, HTN); no individual subject/sample identifiers or per-participant demographic values (age, sex, BMI) are given in the main text, only referenced as being in supplementary tables (e.g., Additional file 1: Table S1) which were not provided.

A validation cohort (n=6, from Qin et al. 2012 study) and a metabolomics subset (n=124) and mouse fecal transplantation experiments were also described but were not treated as separate subgroups for this extraction since the schema pertains to human participant/sample metadata for the primary cohort.

Case-control role and disease fields required inference/mapping from the three named groups (control, pHTN, HTN) to the enum/allowed value space; exact wording from the paper was preserved as much as possible.

This paper is a gut microbiome/hypertension cohort and FMT-to-mouse study, not an oncology/neonatal/obgyn study; most schema fields (tumor staging, RECIST, PFS/OS, neonatal, obgyn, HLA, ECOG) are not applicable and were marked not_reported.

fmt_role and treatment fields required interpretation because the paper's FMT sub-study involves human donors and mouse recipients, which use a different stratification (donor/recipient) than the main human cohort subgroups (control/pHTN/HTN); by_subgroup keys for these fields do not align with the main 'subgroups' list.
smoker field value was inferred from an exclusion criterion (smokers excluded from study) rather than a direct statement of smoking status for included participants.

biomarker_value/biomarker_name fields report the BP classification thresholds used to define subgroups (from Methods), not actual measured biomarker values from Table S1, which were not provided in the given text.

Actual clinical parameter values (SBP, DBP, BMI, FBG, TC, TG, LDL) for each subgroup are referenced as being in Additional file 1: Table S1, but that table's contents were not included in the provided text.

study_name could not be determined from the provided text; only the underlying cohort name 'Kailuan study' was mentioned, not a FirstAuthor_Year identifier.

host_species field only allows a single enum value, but the paper includes both human cohort data and mouse fecal transplant experiments; 'Human' was chosen as the primary disease-association host, with mouse use noted separately.

sequencing_platform for the main metagenomic dataset is only described generically as 'Illumina platform' without model specification; the enum value 'Illumina HiSeq' was inferred from the 16S sequencing methods section, which may not represent the platform used for shotgun metagenomics.
